articles.title: More Layers, More Plants: The Counterintuitive Science of Staying Cool
articles.summary: It sounds backwards, but extra clothing and potted plants can be your best defense against extreme heat. Researchers explain how natural fibers and balcony greenery can drop temperatures by several degrees—no AC required.

articles.title: Not Just Brighter: NASA Maps Reveal a World of Dimming and Glowing Nights
articles.summary: A new analysis of NASA's Black Marble data shows global nighttime radiance increased 34% from 2014 to 2022, but that surge masks widespread dimming. From LED retrofits to war-driven blackouts, the maps tell a complex story of human activity.

articles.title: Medicare's $50 Weight Loss Drug Pilot: Affordable Access, but for How Long?
articles.summary: The Medicare GLP-1 Bridge program launches July 2026, offering popular obesity medications for a $50 copay. But the 18-month pilot excludes low-income subsidies, doesn't count toward out-of-pocket caps, and leaves long-term coverage uncertain.
